Message:
Yubera was always inside
her house painting pictures.

“This is a painting
of my hometown.
It was destroyed
some time ago, though.
That was when
I became a witch.”

Yubera set down her paintbrush,
and brought her fingers
towards the canvas.

“A witch’s power is born
from a wish, right?
If that’s the case, then I...”

Light scattered from
Yubera’s fingertips, and the
dried paint started shining,
as if it had been brought to life.

Her life essence dwindles away
each time she does that,

yet she refuses to put
the paintbrush down.

I see. Yubera’s just like
the two of us.

Fallen into despair over
a power she never wanted,
and looking for a way
to be forgiven.

Just like how she sacrificed
her life to leave me this flower,

Yubera is trying to whittle down
her life essence to make sure
this trace of her hometown
remains.

I raise my hand to touch
the withering flower.

Yubera’s power gives
light to paintings.
It’s not meant to give
this flower life.

I’m sure I only have
a little time left.
I wonder...is there anything
I can leave behind?
